# Kaja

> Open-source agentic harness. Keep looping your prompt with an LLM until the appropriate outcome is achieved.

Kaja is a highly customisable, multi-purpose AI agent: a single executable binary with an event loop, orchestrating various models into context-sensitive, multi-step pipelines. Offline-first — configs are local text files, memory and session data live in a local SQLite database, and it can run entirely without an Internet connection against local models.
